# MH-17 — Close a slot

**Business value:** 890

[Back to index](../README.md)

## User story

As a warden

I want to close a meal slot and cancel all existing reservations

So that no there is no reservation when the service is unavailable


## Notes

In case of problems in the hut (e.g. water or electricity limitations, sick people etc.) they need to close it, thus reservation must be cancelled
